full_judgment: 2. This Rule arises out of the following circumstances: On •15-3•93 Md Mabed Ali Sarker who is opposite party in this Rule and others instituted OC Suit No. 66 of 1993 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Mymensingh, against the petitioner Md Sabdul Ali and others for a decree of permanent injunction in respect of certain lands appertaining to CS khatian Nos. 241, 80 and 259. Subsequently Sabdul Ali filed OC Suit No. 45 of 1994 in the said Court of Assistant Judge for declaration of his title against Md Mabed Ali Sarkar and others in .respect of the land appertaining to aforesaid CS Khatians. In OC Suit No. 45 of 1994. Learned Assistant Judge passed an order on 17-3-94 directing the parties to maintain status quo in respect of the suit land. In spite of the fact that the parties were litigating in the civil Court Mabed Ali Sarker filed an application under section 144 of the Code of Civil Procedure in respect of the self same land against the petitioner which was registered as Non-GR Case No. 157 of 1995 in the Court of the Magistrate, 1st Class, Zone-3, Mymensingh, who by the order dated 8-1-95 converted the proceeding into a proceeding under section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, appointed a receiver in respect of the disputed land and prevented the parties to enter into the disputed land.
